articles.title: She Opened a Random Box—and Found the 'Holy Grail' of Anti-Slavery Documents
articles.summary: A volunteer stumbled upon a 1847 anti-slavery scroll that had been lost for 123 years. Signed by 116 New England ministers, it's a rare, real-time look at the fight against slavery just before the Civil War.

articles.title: The Silk Dress Cryptogram: A 10-Year Code Mystery Solved by... Weather Reports?
articles.summary: A cryptic note hidden in a Victorian dress baffled codebreakers for a decade. The solution? It was a compressed weather telegram from 1888, cracked by a data analyst using old Signal Corps codebooks.

articles.title: V and J-Hope's Priceless Reaction to Drake's BTS Shoutout Breaks the Internet
articles.summary: While listening to Drake's new album Iceman, BTS members V and J-Hope froze in disbelief when they heard themselves name-dropped. The moment, captured on video, has fans hoping for a long-awaited collaboration.
